terminal_assertion_review.label: source-restored-v1
terminal_assertion_review.terminal_state: Gateway echo loss assertion after both cycles disconnected
terminal_assertion_review.limits: A failed restoration smoke test, retained without retry or relabeling. Ethernet captures cannot establish RF reception or locate a station-side loss.

limitations: One board per chip, one AP and room-temperature conditions; no calibrated RF measurement or long-duration reliability claim.
TX detector reference calibration replaced on both chips. Sixteen other TX calibration routines, analog callbacks and ROM dependencies remain; RX archive members stay absent.
Original-instruction oracle compares ordered modeled boundary behavior; it does not prove cycle timing, RF or analog equivalence.

Packet gaps and latency tails remain open. C3 restoration lost gateway sequence8 and reached its explicit loss assertion after both cycles disconnected; this failed smoke test is retained without retry or a passing completion marker.
AP Ethernet captures corroborate EAPOL exchanges but are not complete independent RF captures.

timing_observations.limits: Cumulative metrics cannot correlate a particular packet with an operation. Group losses in the comparison are preserved separately. No cycle-equivalence or packet-loss fix is claimed.

failed_restoration_smoke_test.label: source-restored-v1
failed_restoration_smoke_test.terminal_state: Gateway echo loss assertion after both cycles disconnected
failed_restoration_smoke_test.limits: A failed restoration smoke test, retained without retry or relabeling. Ethernet captures cannot establish RF reception or locate a station-side loss.

final_board_state.esp32c3: ordinary source image retained; both cycles disconnected, halted at Gateway echo loss test assertion (39/40)
final_board_state.esp32s3: held in ROM by paired flasher; ordinary source app retained

validation_notes: Actual emitted TX detector instructions and constants checked in all eight source application profiles: 8,320 case executions. All native PCs and conditional edges are covered, including any explicitly declared outlined Rust reference helper.

Original traces cover single-scalar byte narrowing, six-argument tone setup, two sample calls, halfword stores, both calibration-bit states and helper changes to registers, flags and samples. Analog effects remain outside the model.

The second-sample MMIO read precedes the parameter store on C3 and follows it on S3. Volatile accesses retain that order. Reference calibration leaves the tone running and the low register halfword at 0xaaaa; the wrapper returns to work mode and sets the calibration bit from fresh flags.

All retained TX input names and sizes are compared against control. Selected detector inputs disappear; the sixteen other TX bodies per chip retain vendor ownership. Both RX archive members remain absent.
Images were built at the implementation commit; source hashes and committed Cargo locks bind them to that revision. The control has only the identical passive lifetime probe overlay.
Local Cargo repro tests use installed Rust 1.91.0; serial tests use ESP-IDF Python with pyserial 3.5. Default toolchains and locks are unchanged.
